text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, not long before Grass<n>Wonder's debut
race...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I head to the training course to get<n>everything set
up before Grass<n>Wonder arrives. But when I
arrive...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whew... That'll do.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All warmed up and ready! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay... let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Dashing off with a seemingly<n>effortless burst of
blinding speed is<n>Maruzensky, an Umamusume
who<n>has earned herself countless<n>epithets.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I've seen her on TV, in magazines,and online plenty of times before, butseeing her run in person... Her form isbreathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That was fantabulous!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since she tends to take an immediate<n>lead in her
races, Maruzensky is<n>generally classified as a front
runner.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But it seems like less of a conscious<n>strategy, and
more that she's so<n>impossibly fast, no one else
can get<n>ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All revved up... so now I floor it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A fearsome "Beast," through and<n>through. She's
well-deserving of the<n>nickname.
choice_data_list: Grass! I didn't know you were here.
Grass! I didn't know you were here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I just arrived, actually. I'm ready to<n>begin at your
earliest convenience.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We don't have time to waste on<n>gazing in
admiration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let us focus squarely on our own<n>efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's fighting spirit burns<n>bright and
never wavers, not even in<n>the presence of the
Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I conduct her training with a<n>strengthened sense of
purpose to<n>help get her to the very top.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On another day...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder joins a scrimmage<n>with other
Umamusume scheduled to<n>debut the same time as
her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pant...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-wow... Grass's acceleration is<n>incredible!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Talk about scary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When she gets that "gotcha!" look in<n>her eyes,
Grass is the last person I<n>want to be up against...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Really? That look gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, most of us aren't masochists,<n>unlike you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué dices?!
Only 200 left! Grass is leading!
Huff... huff... huff...

Grass Wonder leaves the rest of the<n>competition in
the dust and takes first<n>place.

1,600 meters of turf in just a minute<n>and thirty-four
seconds... It's hard to<n>believe this is the work of a
junior-year racer!

The reporters who came to the<n>scrimmage also
take notice of Grass<n>Wonder.

Hooooly moly... Fantastic! What was<n>her name
again?
It's Grass Wonder.

I couldn't be happier seeing you<n>enjoy this
scrimmage between the<n>up-and-coming
Umamusume.

Oh, Symboli Rudolf! I was able to<n>capture so many
great pictures today!<n>Especially of that last runner!

Who in this generation has the most<n>potential in
your eyes?

Well, it goes without saying that every<n>Umamusume
has a great deal of<n>potential.

For one, there's El Condor Pasa. She<n>proudly
claims to be the world's<n>strongest racer, and
makes an<n>inspiring amount of effort to keep
improving.

Then there's Seiun Sky. She tends to<n>stay out of
the spotlight, but once<n>she's on the track, you see
just how<n>many tricks are up her sleeve.

Another one of note is Special Week.<n>Despite the
challenges she seems to<n>be facing adjusting to her
new<n>surroundings, no one can deny the<n>brilliance of
her skill.

Mhm! Right, right! Those names have<n>all come up a
lot recently!

I'm sure they have. But let's not<n>forget Grass
Wonder.

Oh! The Umamusume from the race<n>just now!
Which reminds me...

One minute and thirty-four seconds<n>over a distance
of 1600 meters...<n>That's the same as a certain
record<n>performance at the Asahi Hai F.S.!

Surely nobody could see that time and<n>not be
reminded of the legendary<n>Beast, Maruzensky!

Yes... Now that you mention it, the<n>similarities are
quite the remarkable<n>coincidence.
Yeah, yeah! And you know what that<n>means?

Grass Wonder could be the next<n>Maruzensky! You
could even go so<n>far as to call her the "Beast's
Successor"!
Graaass! Great race! Your time was<n>amazing!
...Grass?
Huh? Oh...
Thank you, Spe.
The... "Beast's Successor," you say?

I sure do! Everyone in the media<n>booth was saying
so after seeing her<n>race today! She's got what it
takes to<n>live up to those expectations!

Maruzensky is so dominant that just<n>saying her
name brings so many<n>legendary moments to mind.

And just between us, it was<n>precisely that "Hot
Rod" who inspired<n>me to become a huge
Umamusume<n>fan!
Quite understandable.

Not only is she undefeated, but in just<n>eight races
since her debut, she<n>achieved an unprecedented
sum of<n>61 lengths in their combined margins<n>of
victory.

That commanding lead has inspired<n>people to refer
to her races as "solo<n>journeys," giving her such an
intimidating reputation...

...it's even resulted in Umamusume<n>withdrawing
from their scheduled<n>races just because they
know<n>Maruzensky will be entering.

I know, right?! I heard they almost<n>had to cancel a
race 'cause there<n>weren't enough participants!

It's good that it didn't come to that,<n>but even so...
The fact that she's<n>never found herself in a race
with a<n>double-digit racer count is a crazy feat<n>in its
own right!

That's why people started calling her<n>the Beast in
the first place... But now,<n>Grass Wonder has
entered the<n>picture!
...Hmm.
She's already this strong, and shehasn't even debuted yet! Heck, shehasn't even been scouted yet!

And what's more, she's got that<n>unshakable
serene confidence! She<n>makes her wins look so
effortless,<n>other racers can't hope to compete!

She's right up there with<n>Maruzensky! I think the
Beast's<n>Successor would be the perfect<n>nickname
for her!
You make an intriguing point.

As you might surmise from my<n>naming her as an
example, I also<n>have high hopes for Grass Wonder.
But I say that because...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey Grass, are you going back to the<n>dorm after
this? We could go togeth—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Spe, but I can't.

I'm going to drop by the gym, so<n>please go on
ahead without me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H... huh?! You're going to the gym at<n>this hour?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I say that because...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder herself carries<n>unyielding
determination to reach the<n>top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...The Beast's Successor.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should feel honored to be mentioned<n>in the same
breath as her. But...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The title of "Successor" isn't suitable<n>for one who
stands at the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I could never be content with it.
